maya: Heads up — main CI went red right after my merge (PR #3421). fast-build job failing on linux-x86.
maya: Saw it in the pipeline dashboard, marking as P0 for now. Can someone grab quick eyes? :eyes:
ci-bot: pipeline:main | job:fast-build | status: FAILED | build_id: build-8842
ci-bot: First failing step: compile-core (exit code 2)
sam: On it, pinging infra owner. Can you paste the tail of the log, maya?
maya: here you go:
```
error: /workspace/include/quant/kernel.h: No such file or directory
#0  0x7f3a2a in compile_module()
#1  0x55a1ab in main
```
sam: hmm looks like an include/config drift. That header should be generated by bazel-genfiles during genproto.
liam: Is this the change that touched build config in tools/packager? If so, maybe prod variant skipped gen step.
maya: I changed an option in tools/packager/BUILD.bazel — added `select()` to choose qkernel impl per platform. I can revert if needed.
sam: Before revert, can we rerun just the job to rule out flake? liam, can you trigger a rerun for build-8842? If rerun hits same error, we bisect.
liam: re-run triggered: `./ci/rerun build-8842 --job fast-build` (queued)
ci-bot: build-8842 (rerun-1) started on builders/linux-x86-12
maya: thanks. If rerun fails, I can push a minimal revert but would prefer to confirm.
ci-bot: build-8842 (rerun-1) FAILED — same compile-core error
sam: ok same failure. maya, can you try adding the header generation step explicitly in your branch? quick fix: add `genrule` dependency to the target that needs kernel.h
maya: yeah I can try a patch now, will push under `maya/packager-quickfix` and re-run.
liam: tagging @maya for the revert plan: if fix takes >15m we'll roll back.
maya: pushed patch: `maya/packager-quickfix` -> adds deps, bumped BUILD.bazel
ci-bot: new build queued from branch maya/packager-quickfix -> build-8843
ci-bot: build-8843 started
ci-bot: build-8843 SUCCESS :white_check_mark:
sam: nice — confirm prod variants green? liam, can you run smoke across the matrix for a sanity check?
liam: kicking off matrix smoke: jobs: fast-build, integration-smoke (linux, mac)
ci-bot: integration-smoke (linux) started
ci-bot: integration-smoke (linux) PASSED
ci-bot: integration-smoke (mac) PASSED
liam: all green. maya, can you open a follow-up PR to make the BUILD.bazel change explicit (with a comment) so this doesn't silently regress? Also add a tiny CI test that catches missing generated headers.
maya: yep opened PR #3422 with tests + explanation. Leaving this thread — thanks for quick turnaround. :tada:
sam: awesome, thanks everyone. Marking original merge as safe; will keep an eye on the next few commits.
ci-bot: pipeline:main | status: STABLE (after fixes)
